# Test Fixtures

These fixtures are intentionally small and independent of the full Bently book corpus.
They support fast regression tests for Phase-0 schemas and the S1 -> S2 -> S3 -> V4 chain.

## Files

- `raw/small_vibration_native.pdf`: one-page native-text PDF used for fast S1 ingestion tests.
- `raw/small_vibration_zh.pdf`: two-page native-text Chinese PDF used for bilingual and cross-page regression tests.
- `raw/small_vibration_zh.docx`: one logical-page Chinese DOCX used for Obj4 DOCX ingestion tests.
- `ocr/sample_pages.jsonl`: page-level parse fixture matching `OcrPage`.
- `chunks/sample_chunks.jsonl`: chunk fixture matching `MemoryChunk`.
- `retrieval/sample_retrieval.json`: retrieval fixture matching `RetrievalOutput`.
- `ocr/sample_zh_pages.jsonl`, `chunks/sample_zh_chunks.jsonl`, and `retrieval/sample_zh_retrieval.json`: Chinese fixture pack with one chunk spanning pages 1-2.
- `ocr/sample_zh_docx_pages.jsonl` and `chunks/sample_zh_docx_chunks.jsonl`: parser-derived DOCX baseline used to detect DOCX extraction/chunking drift.

## Regeneration Policy

The PDFs are generated with PyMuPDF from short rotor-vibration paragraphs. The PDF
Chinese fixture pack is regenerated by `scripts/generate_obj2_fixtures.py`.

The DOCX fixture is generated with `python-docx` from matching rotor-damping paragraphs
and a small table. The DOCX fixture pack is regenerated by
`scripts/generate_obj4_docx_fixtures.py`, which writes the DOCX source, parses it through
the real DOCX parser, and emits page/chunk baselines.
If the parser or chunker format changes, regenerate the page/chunk fixtures from these source
fixtures and update the golden regression assertions in `tests/unit/test_regression_fixtures.py`
in the same change.

Keep fixture paths portable: use forward slashes in JSON fields even on Windows.
